title: voucher_batch
description: A bulk voucher issuance request (YT-0141). Two-person approval, always.

businessId.description: NOT required, unlike a business-side route on this kind: TASKS.md 9.2.c's staff moderation queue names no single business in its URL (a list has none at all; approve/reject name a requestId, not a businessId) -- see business.json's own comment for the same reasoning. Cerbos runs with enforcement: reject, so requiring it would fail schema validation, and therefore deny, every staff moderation route before any rule ran. Absence is safe: `nobody-approves-their-own-batch` and the business-side derived roles all begin with has(R.attr.businessId) / has(R.attr.requestedBy).

region.description: 1.5.b's F2 hard wall: the business's own region, compared against P.attr.jurisdiction.
